name.en: Australian passport photo
name.zh: 澳大利亚护照照片

notes.en: Two good-quality colour prints: 35–40 mm wide and 45–50 mm high; face (chin to crown) 32–36 mm. Because photo height is a range, head_ratio is left null. Less than 6 months old; glossy heavy-weight paper, not inkjet; plain white or light grey background. No glasses except for documented medical reasons. Pixel size, file limits, and DPI are not stated. Exact width/height are left null; ranges are in the optional min/max print fields.
notes.zh: 两张合格彩色照片：宽 35–40 mm、高 45–50 mm；面部（下巴到头顶）32–36 mm。因高度为区间，head_ratio 留空。不超过 6 个月；厚铜版光面、非喷墨；白或浅灰纯背景。除有医疗证明外不戴眼镜。未写像素、文件限制与 DPI。精确宽高留空，区间写在可选 min/max 字段。

sources.title: Australian Passport Office: Passport photos

name.en: Canada passport photo (print, in person or by mail)
name.zh: 加拿大护照照片（纸质，当面或邮寄）

notes.en: In-person or mail applications: two identical unaltered photos, 50 mm × 70 mm; face (chin to crown) 31–36 mm (about 0.443–0.514 of 70 mm); taken no more than 6 months before submission; colour or black and white; plain white or light-coloured background. Pixel size and file limits are not stated for prints. Online renewal uses a different digital spec (JPEG, 3:2 portrait, 1200×1800 to 3000×4500 pixels, 200 KB–5 MB, chin-to-crown 45–50%) which is not this entry.
notes.zh: 当面或邮寄：两张未改动的相同照片，50 mm × 70 mm；面部（下巴到头顶）31–36 mm（约占 70 mm 的 0.443–0.514）；提交前不超过 6 个月；彩色或黑白；白或浅色纯背景。印刷照未写像素与文件限制。在线更新为另一套数字规格（JPEG、3:2 竖图、1200×1800 至 3000×4500、200 KB–5 MB、头高 45–50%），不在本条。

sources.title: Canada.ca: Passport photo requirements

name.en: People's Republic of China passport / travel-document photo
name.zh: 中华人民共和国护照 / 旅行证照片

specs.issuer: National Immigration Administration / Chinese diplomatic missions

notes.en: Chinese consular page (same wording on multiple MFA missions): colour print taken within 6 months; white background; 33 mm wide × 48 mm high; head width 15–22 mm; head height (chin to crown) 28–33 mm (about 0.583–0.688 of 48 mm); 3–5 mm from crown to the top edge; at least 7 mm from chin to the bottom edge. Full face visible; glasses allowed if untinted and without glare. Pixel size, file limits, and DPI are not stated. Domestic applications follow the NIA “出入境证件相片照相指引” archive and may be captured in office; this entry records the published millimetre rules used by missions.
notes.zh: 中国驻外使领馆页（多馆表述一致）：6 个月内彩色纸质近照；白底；宽 33 mm、高 48 mm；头部宽 15–22 mm；头部高（下巴到头顶）28–33 mm（约占 48 mm 的 0.583–0.688）；头顶到上边 3–5 mm；下巴到下边不少于 7 mm。须含整个面部；可戴无色、无反光眼镜。未写像素、文件限制与 DPI。境内申请另循国家移民管理局《出入境证件相片照相指引》，可能现场采集；本条记录馆方公布的毫米规则。

name.en: Mainland China passport photo (online upload)
name.zh: 中国大陆护照照片（网上办理）

notes.en: NIA “全程网办” photo guide (checked 2026-10-12). Verbatim: 「选一个 白色 或 浅蓝色 的背景」「照片宽度应在 400像素～1000像素之间」「宽高比为3:4」「头像宽度占图片宽度的2/3 较为合适」. White stored as #FFFFFF; light-blue hex is not named. “较为合适” is not stored as a required head-height ratio. File format, byte limits (including 20–80 KB), print millimetres, DPI and an exact export height are not in that quote. Missing format and file size keeps needs-review.
notes.zh: 国家移民管理局《出入境证件「全程网办」照片提交指引》（2026-10-12 核对）。原文：「选一个 白色 或 浅蓝色 的背景」「照片宽度应在 400像素～1000像素之间」「宽高比为3:4」「头像宽度占图片宽度的2/3 较为合适」。白色记为 #FFFFFF；浅蓝无色值。「较为合适」不记为必须头部比例。该原文没有格式、字节上下限（含 20–80 KB）、印刷毫米、DPI 与精确高度。缺格式与文件大小，保持 needs-review。

name.en: National civil service exam confirmation photo (source image)
name.zh: 中央机关及其直属机构考试录用公务员报名确认照片（源图）

specs.issuer: National Civil Service Administration (报考指南, 2026 session)

notes.en: From the 2026 national civil service exam applicant guide: the source photo uploaded into the official photo-processing tool must be a recent bareheaded front-facing digital ID photo, blue or white background, JPG/JPEG, width at least 295 pixels and height at least 413 pixels, with no beautification. The tool’s output size is not published on the guide. File KB limits, print millimetres, DPI, and head ratio are not stated. Hex for “blue” is not stated; white is recorded as #FFFFFF. The guide is issued for the official topic site bm.scs.gov.cn; this entry cites government republications of that guide.
notes.zh: 2026 年国考《报考指南》：须先用官方“照片处理工具”处理。源图为本人近期免冠正面电子证件照，蓝底或白底，JPG/JPEG，宽不低于 295 像素、高不低于 413 像素，不得美化。工具输出尺寸未公布。KB、印刷毫米、DPI、头部比例未写。蓝色无官方色值，白底记为 #FFFFFF。指南面向专题网站 bm.scs.gov.cn；本条引用政府网站转载文本。

notes.en: CICPA 2026 registration notice for first-time applicants: photo taken within the last year; “1-cun” front-facing bareheaded white-background ID photo; JPG/JPEG; 2–20 KB; 178×220 pixels; resolution at least 96×96 dots per inch. Print millimetres are not stated (the “1-cun” label is not converted here). Colour vs grayscale is not stated. The photo is used on the admission ticket and the qualification certificate. Pixel/mm/DPI consistency is not checked because print_mm is null.
notes.zh: 中注协 2026 年报名通知（首次报名）：最近 1 年内 1 寸正面免冠白底证件照；jpg/jpeg；2–20K；178×220 像素；分辨率至少每英寸 96×96 点。未写印刷毫米（“1 寸”未换算）。未写必须彩色。用于准考证与合格证书。因无印刷毫米，不做像素/毫米/DPI 一致性校验。

name.ja: 日本国旅券申請用写真

notes.en: MOFA: borderless photo 45 mm high × 35 mm wide; no background (white recommended); taken within 6 months before the application date; bareheaded, facing forward; chin-to-crown 34±2 mm (32–36 mm, about 0.711–0.800 of 45 mm). Pixel size, file limits, DPI, colour vs grayscale, and head ratio are not stated on those pages. Some missions also accept 45×45 mm; check the mission that will receive the application.
notes.zh: 外务省签证申请表贴相片处：45 mm × 35 mm（或 2 in × 1.4 in），本条记为宽 35 mm × 高 45 mm。日本驻特立尼达和多巴哥大使馆官方页：一张 45 mm × 35 mm 护照照片，近 6 个月内拍摄，白底。上述页未写像素、文件限制、DPI、是否必须彩色与头部比例。部分馆也接受 45×45 mm，以受理馆为准。

name.en: TOPIK registration photo

specs.issuer: National Institute for International Education (NIIED) / TOPIK

notes.en: From the 2026 TOPIK implementation notice: registration photos follow the Ministry of Justice foreigner-registration photo standard. Colour, upper-body, front-facing, passport-style, identical print, 3.5 cm wide × 4.5 cm high, taken within 6 months of the start of registration. Eyes must not be hidden by hair or frames; no hat covering the head. Digital photos must not be altered from the original. Background must be a single solid colour with no extra backdrop. Pixel size, file format, KB limits, DPI, and a named background hex are not stated.
notes.zh: 2026 年 TOPIK 实施公告：报名照片准用韩国法务部外国人登记用照片规格。彩色、上半身、正面、护照式、同一底片，横 3.5 cm × 纵 4.5 cm，须在报名开始日起近 6 个月内拍摄。头发或镜框不得遮眼，不得以帽子遮头。数码照片禁止用软件改原图。背景须为单色、无另外布景。像素、格式、KB、DPI 与具体底色色值未写明。

notes.en: Online UK passport applications: digital photo taken in the last month; colour; unaltered; at least 600 pixels wide and 750 pixels tall; at least 50 KB and no more than 10 MB. Plain light-coloured background (hex not named; #FFFFFF stored as a default light colour). Include head, shoulders and upper body if you take the photo yourself — do not crop; cropping is done in the service. File format is not named on this page (photo-code guidance elsewhere says JPEG). Head ratio, print millimetres, and DPI are not stated.
notes.zh: 英国护照在线申请：近 1 个月内数字照片；彩色、未经软件改动；至少 600×750 像素；50 KB–10 MB。浅色纯背景（未给色值，默认记 #FFFFFF）。若自行拍摄须包含头、肩与上身，不要裁切，由系统裁切。本页未写文件格式（另页照片码说明为 JPEG）。未写头部比例、印刷毫米与 DPI。

specs.issuer: U.S. Department of State — Passport Services

notes.en: Paper / in-person applications: one colour photo taken in the last 6 months; printed size 2×2 inches (51×51 mm); head (chin to top of head) 1–1 3/8 inches (25–35 mm), i.e. 0.5–0.6875 of photo height. White or off-white plain background. Neutral expression, mouth closed; no glasses. Pixel dimensions, file format, and KB limits for a printed photo are not stated. Online renewal uses a separate digital-upload page and is not this entry.
notes.zh: 纸质/当面申请：近 6 个月内彩色照片一张；印刷尺寸 2×2 英寸（51×51 mm）；头部（下巴到头顶）1–1 3/8 英寸（25–35 mm），约占照片高度 0.5–0.6875。白或灰白纯色背景。表情自然、闭口；不戴眼镜。印刷照未写像素、格式与 KB。在线更新另有数字上传页，不在本条。

name.en: U.S. nonimmigrant visa photo (DS-160 digital upload)
name.zh: 美国非移民签证照片（DS-160 数字上传）

specs.issuer: U.S. Department of State — Bureau of Consular Affairs

notes.en: Digital image: square JPEG; 600×600 to 1200×1200 pixels; 24-bit sRGB; ≤240 KB; compression ratio ≤20:1. Head (top of hair to chin) 50–69% of image height; eyes 56–69% of image height from the bottom (eye band not stored as a separate field). DPI is left null because the digital-upload table does not require a DPI; if you scan an existing 2×2 inch (51×51 mm) print, the same page says to scan at 300 ppi. Composition template matches the same square pixel range. Glasses have not been allowed in visa photos since 1 November 2016. Background colour is required to be plain; a white/off-white background is the usual composition on the same State Department photo pages. Minimum file size is not stated.
notes.zh: 数字图像：正方形 JPEG；600×600 至 1200×1200 像素；24 位 sRGB；≤240 KB；压缩比 ≤20:1。头部（发顶到下巴）占图像高度 50–69%；眼睛高度为自底部起 56–69%（眼位未单列字段）。DPI 留空，因为数字上传表未要求 DPI；若扫描已有 2×2 英寸（51×51 mm）纸质照，同页要求 300 ppi。构图模板与上述像素范围一致。2016-11-01 起签证照片不得戴眼镜。底色须平整；国务院照片页通常为白/灰白。未写最小文件。
